name: PHENYTOIN SODIUM 100MG 50 TABLETS
description: Phenytoin sodium 100 mg in a 50-tablet presentation is an anticonvulsant medication. It is used to control and prevent certain types of seizures, such as generalized tonic-clonic seizures and focal seizures, as well as seizures that may occur during or after brain surgery. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
